name: desktop-illustrator-mcp
description: Safely control local Illustrator 2020 through a guarded Windows COM MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Illustrator with guarded COM automation.
interface.longDescription: Installs a pinned local Illustrator 2020 MCP runtime, discovers the active Windows COM registration, and keeps its ExtendScript editing interface behind explicit approval prompts.
defaultPrompt: 检查本机 Illustrator MCP 状态，并告诉我可用的操作。
在 Illustrator 中按要求修改当前图稿，保存前先征求确认。
诊断 Illustrator MCP 连接，但不要执行脚本或截图。
